description.en: Assumed standard weekly cost of formal childcare per eligible child (EUR 400/week, unchanged since 2024). It is used in xcc_nl's first BenCalc component (function comment 'Costs') as the Comp_perElig amount added once for every eligible child meeting the condition 'dag 0-4 & dccfc=1' (aged 0 to 4 and recorded/flagged as using formal daycare); an inline parameter comment in the model notes the figure assumes a standard 40-hour working week of care. This produces the output variable xcc_s, the imputed weekly childcare cost per child, which the policy's second BenCalc component ('Childcare benefit') then multiplies by income- and child-rank-tested compensation rates (built from the $bccfc_* family of constants, e.g. $bccfc_child2_thres1/thres2 for the second and later children) to compute the modelled childcare-fee compensation (bccfc_s) - EUROMOD's approximation of the Dutch childcare allowance (kinderopvangtoeslag).
